transform.description: Column-major 2×3 `[xx, xy, yx, yy, tx, ty]`.

oneOf.description: The vertices strictly between the start and end node.
A plane model with the unit normal of its plane.

Dof.description: One DOF: restrained (`fixed`), free, or elastic.

oneOf.description: The local frame of this member.

EndOffsets.description: Rigid offsets from node to member end.

eccentricity.description: Member-wide (ey, ez), local axes; the profile moves by +e.

profile_position.description: The profile definition's own Position, `[xx, xy, yx, yy, tx, ty]`.

nodes.description: Start, intermediate (ordered along the member), end.

z.description: Unit local z, perpendicular to the axis; always given.

shared_frame.description: Column-major 4×4, world metres (IFC SharedPlacement); identity when absent.

frame.description: Skewed support frame: the frame's x, y and z axes in global coordinates.

Props.description: Section properties as the source gives them; all optional.

Release.description: A member-end release (always member local): `dofs` (`fixed` = connected), `named`, or both.

inline.description: Inline result blocks, base64, by table name.

Shape.description: Section shapes in metres, origin at the bounding-box centre. Radii and slopes default to 0.

global_transform.description: Column-major 4×4 applied to reach the Z-up global frame (rigid).

Support.description: A nodal or line support: `dofs`, or a `named` type from the preset table, or both.

oneOf.description: `[u, v, p]` samples in the surface plane.
Part of a member, absolute metres from its start node.
Three points of the plane `[x, y, z, t]`.

origin.description: The anchor the viewer subtracts for display, world metres.
